bluf: BBC News World reported that continuing Russian strikes are hampering efforts to recover bodies after a double-tap strike in southern Ukraine. France 24 reported that Russian strikes on two bridges in Kyiv disrupted water and power supplies. A third US aircraft carrier has arrived in the Middle East, US Central Command said.

changes.text: Updated since previous brief: Iran claims attack on US military airbase in Bahrain

cyber.text: BleepingComputer reported that a Kazakh national was extradited from Italy to the US to face charges alleging ransomware attacks targeting US schools, hospitals and healthcare entities.

items.text: BBC News World reported that officials said continuing Russian strikes were hampering efforts to recover bodies after a double-tap strike in southern Ukraine. Ukraine accused Russia of targeting the rescue operation.
France 24 reported that Russian forces struck two bridges across the Dnipro River in Kyiv late Monday, causing water and power cuts in parts of the city.
The Guardian World reported that Ukraine hit the Kerch bridge linking Russia and occupied Crimea during an overnight drone barrage, temporarily restricting traffic.
The Guardian World reported that Ukraine critically damaged the Kerch bridge in an overnight missile attack, leaving it no longer usable.
Al Jazeera reported that a Moscow-installed governor said traffic was suspended after a second attack on the bridge between Crimea and Russia in two days.
A third US aircraft carrier arrived in the Middle East, US Central Command said, bringing thousands more troops to the region.
Al Jazeera reported that Bahrain thwarted a drone attack and that Iran claimed to have targeted US radar. The IRGC said the attack was intended to counter US forces' activities in the region.
